headline: Greens, but make it fun.
alt: Three cartoon lime-green gummy mascots, one shouting into a megaphone, leap around an orange Snapleaf tub amid apple-lime splashes.

headline: Slow mornings start here.
alt: A hand in a cream knit sleeve holds a sage-and-oat Hushroom mushroom coffee canister up to the camera in a sunlit kitchen.
subline: Cocoa-smooth mushroom coffee. One scoop. One stir.

headline: Less, but better.
alt: A black-and-white hand lifts the dropper of the only object in colour, a frosted Aurive serum bottle with a gold collar.

headline: Baked at 6. Gone by 10.
alt: A rustic bakery counter piled with sourdough, baguettes and croissants around a Korrel Bakehouse paper bag in early-morning light.

headline: Welcome to Greensville.
alt: A golden-hour miniature village of broccoli trees, pea hedges and gummy cottages with the Snapleaf tub on the hilltop like a castle.

headline: what's in your mug? 👀
alt: A casual phone photo of an opened Hushroom canister, a mug of mushroom coffee and half-eaten toast, with an Instagram question sticker on top.
subline: my new 7am ritual. tastes like cocoa.

headline: Every detail, considered.
alt: A clean infographic of the Aurive serum bottle with thin callout lines labelling the dropper, gold collar, frosted glass and serum texture.
subline: Dropper, collar, frosted glass and texture, called out.

headline: Sundays taste better here.
alt: A candid Sunday brunch: friends' hands, cropped at the chin, share croissants, a cinnamon bun, sourdough and cappuccinos beside a Korrel bag.

headline: Not your usual greens.
alt: A giant sugar-crusted lime-green gummy glows on a black mirror floor next to a small orange Snapleaf tub.

headline: Nothing to hide.
alt: A top-down flat-lay of the Hushroom canister and a mug surrounded by labelled coffee beans, cacao nibs, cinnamon, lion's mane and chaga.

headline: Edit your shelf.
alt: A split image: a crowded shelf of plain unbranded bottles on the left, a single Aurive serum on travertine on the right.
subline: The usual way vs the Aurive way.

headline: Coffee's on us.
alt: A cream offer card reading "Coffee's on us" beside a Korrel paper bag, a sourdough loaf and a latte on a wooden counter.
subline: Free filter coffee with any loaf, weekdays before 9am.

headline: 20% off your first box
alt: A bold lime-green offer card with "20% off your first box" and a coupon code next to an open Snapleaf tub spilling gummies.
subline: Code HELLO20 · Greens gummies, Apple Lime.

headline: Rise slow.
alt: A cut-paper sunrise over sage and terracotta paper hills and paper mushrooms, with the Hushroom canister on a cardboard podium.

headline: One drop. That's the routine.
alt: A macro shot of a single golden serum drop hanging from the Aurive glass pipette above the open frosted bottle.

headline: Worth every crumb.
alt: A hand pulls open a golden butter croissant close to the camera, showing its flaky honeycomb layers, with a Korrel bag behind.
